name: Parent Notification of Controlled Substance Incident
description: Notice to parents of students directly involved in a violation, including whether police have been or may be notified; attempts documented.
quote: The Superintendent or designee shall notify the parent/guardian of any student directly involved in an incident involving a violation of this Policy, as soon as practicable. The Superintendent or designee shall inform the parent/guardian whether or not the local police department that has jurisdiction over the school property has been or may be notified of the incident.
